a.lede: Microsoft is warning customers that a security vulnerability in Azure API Management (APIM) Classic tiers was exploited to steal stored API credentials, with Norwegian authorities linking the flaw to cyberattacks against energy companies. [...]
a.title: Microsoft Azure flaw exploited to steal customers' API credentials

b.lede: The British cyber agency says that "building strong foundations has never mattered more" as AI hacking tools rely on exploiting simple security flaws.
b.title: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
